maddeler.e:
اقلعفوا (form IVq)
# اِقْلَعَفُّوا (iqlaʕaffū) /iq.la.ʕaf.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
# اُقْلُعِفُّوا (uqluʕiffū) /uq.lu.ʕif.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
# اِقْلَعِفُّوا (iqlaʕiffū) /iq.la.ʕif.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
